note: EIA weekly US residential heating oil and propane prices for the week of 2026-10-19, plus the week before (item@w1) and the same week a year earlier (item@y1). Stored in US dollars per litre (published US dollars per gallon / 3.785411784). One national average per series and week, so low/high/min/max repeat it and no record count is stored (n is empty). EIA collects these prices only from October to March, so outside the season the newest week is from March.
